title: Nico Asked for $4,000 More. It Became $45,000

scenes.say: One email asking for $4,000 more could add up to about $45,000 for Nico.
His job offer was $58,000, and he almost signed on the spot.
Instead, he asked for $62,000, based on what similar jobs pay. They agreed.
That's about $333 more a month, before taxes.
And raises are percentages, so that gap grows every single year.
With raises around 3% a year, ten years adds up to roughly $45,000.
His script: research the pay range, ask for one number, and get it in writing.
Have you ever asked for more? Subscribe, because one email could mean $45,000 more.
